about: Pre-switch retrieval gate for ident_v2 (2026-10-15). Representative CIVIL drafting requests; expected provision = what the official Pakistan Code CPC text (pdf administrator6598dab..., 'Under Review') headings show for the request -- developer labels, provisional, not lawyer-reviewed. Topics of the locked holdout v3 are deliberately excluded (temporary injunction, local commission, execution attachment, superdari, acquittal, bail cancellation, dower, guardianship, eviction, earnest money, defamation). The dev cases V01-V08 are added by the gate script from cases_v2.jsonl.
